description: A large knob that sends a pitch voltage to the Luci cells patched to it

params.text: Sets the rate sent to the cells, 0 to 8 on the knob and twice that at the output

inputs.text: Nothing in the module reads this jack; the output is computed from the knob alone, twice over, because the code adds the knob to itself instead of adding the jack

outputs.text: Carries twice the knob setting, 0V to 16V, which a Luci cell reads as a volt per octave

notes: the output is double what the knob shows, because the code adds the knob to itself
